source: Provincial Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Pursat Province — សារធាតុចិញ្ចឹមសម្រាប់ដំណាំស្រូវ (Nutrients for the Rice Crop), presenter Yem Sophy, 20 Nov 2017, p.6
text: Inorganic fertilizer, also called chemical fertilizer (ជីអសរីរាង្គ ឬជីគីមី), is fertilizer manufactured in factories and sold in granular, liquid, or powder form. These fertilizers generally contain a high concentration of the nutrients plants need and can typically be used directly by the crop.
